levels.label: Disposable target
levels.status_display: Scenario binds to an exact Git revision
levels.allowed_claim: A local scenario can be previewed and run in a detached worktree bound to a target revision.
levels.forbidden_inference: The primary checkout's unrelated dirty files have been fully exercised in this fixture.

levels.label: Cleanup proof
levels.status_display: Clean state removed; dirty state retained
levels.allowed_claim: The prototype removes clean sandboxes and retains dirty sandboxes until the owned artifact is gone.
levels.forbidden_inference: Process inactivity or port ownership has been proven.

levels.label: Cancellation state
levels.allowed_claim: The current prototype records a cancellation-shaped exit and makes the missing distinct state visible.
levels.forbidden_inference: Cancellation has a dedicated state or cleanup path.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The sandbox case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
